Subject: Re: Audit export window question (e-discovery)

Hi Sam — thanks for the details and the attachment. Quick answers up front, then steps: 

Summary answers:
- Audit trails (configuration changes, role grants, admin actions): default hosted retention = 12 months; Dedicated/Private customers can opt in to longer retention (24–36 months) via configuration and additional storage.
- Access logs (token requests, authentication events, API access): default hosted retention = 90 days. We can extend to 12 months for Dedicated or under an enterprise retention add-on.
- Export formats: NDJSON (recommended), CSV (for smaller slices), and a pre-built archival tar.gz that includes metadata manifest and schema.
- Backfill: For hosted tenants we can provide export backfill up to 12 months from the current date if data still exists in hot/cold storage. For anything older we will need to scope retrieval (cold archive restores) and that typically takes 3–7 business days and may incur import fees. For Dedicated/Private we can support arbitrary retention if you provisioned it when data was collected.

Steps we propose:
1) Please confirm the exact field list in the attached evidence request that you need in the export (we highlighted recommended Redwood field names in the sample we attach).
2) If you need 18 months of history and you're on hosted, we'll scope a cold-archive restore (estimate 3–7 business days). If you're on Dedicated/Private, we can export directly if retention was configured.
3) We'll produce an NDJSON export with a manifest and SHA256 checksums and provide a secure download link (S3 presigned URL) valid for 7 days.

Copying Aditya for export SLA and Lauren for formal confirmation and PO/invoicing if any fees apply.

Best,

— Soojin Lee

On Mon, Nov 23, 2026 at 12:08 PM Soojin Lee wrote:
> Quick answers up front...

Couple of operational clarifications from the exports team:

- SLA: Cold-archive restores (when we need to pull > default window) are typically completed in 3 business days for up to 6 months of data; for multi-month/multi-GB restores (e.g., 18 months of audit/activity for a large org) estimate 5–7 business days. We will confirm after scoping.
- Deletion triggers: Hosted data deletion follows the configured retention policy. We do not perform proactive deletions outside retention windows unless a customer submits a deletion request (subject to verification and legal hold exemptions). If an external legal hold is in place, we will suspend deletion for affected objects until release.
- Scoped exports include a manifest linking each row to the originating storage shard and timestamp so you can demonstrate chain-of-custody.

If ACME confirms fields, we will open an internal export ticket and provide a timeline and cost estimate (if cold-archive work required).

— Aditya
Engineering Operations (Exports)
